description: Complete V1 release-readiness fixes for the Confluence-to-Notion Chrome extension: runtime permissions, OAuth deployability, display URL identity, in-place assets, upload expiry, partial write visibility, and live popup progress.

userStories.title: Declare MV3 runtime permissions for OAuth and Confluence hosts
userStories.description: As a user, I need the installed extension to have the Chrome permissions required to connect Notion and request access to my configured Confluence host.
acceptanceCriteria: `public/manifest.json` includes the `identity` permission required by `chrome.identity` OAuth flow
`public/manifest.json` declares optional host permissions that allow requesting a configured `http` or `https` Confluence origin at runtime
`public/manifest.json` does not request `cookies` permission or `<all_urls>` host access
Confluence permission helpers still request only the normalized configured origin, not a broader pattern
Release checklist tests fail if identity permission or requestable Confluence optional host permissions are absent
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Declared identity permission and http/https optional host permissions with release checklist coverage.

userStories.title: Make Notion OAuth configuration deployable and clear
userStories.description: As a user, I need Notion Connect to either run with a real configured OAuth client ID or fail with clear setup guidance instead of using a placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: Default Notion OAuth client ID is read from an explicit build-time or configuration source instead of a hardcoded placeholder value
OAuth start rejects missing or placeholder client IDs before launching `chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow`
OAuth configuration failure returns a user-visible message explaining that the extension build is missing Notion OAuth client configuration
OAuth callback validation and token persistence behavior remain unchanged for valid configuration
Unit tests cover valid client ID, missing client ID, placeholder client ID, and callback success behavior
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added build-time NOTION_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID injection, pre-launch missing/placeholder validation, clear Options UI guidance, and OAuth coverage.

userStories.title: Bridge display URL page identity from content to background
userStories.description: As a user, I need `/display/{SPACE}/{Page+Title}` Confluence links to save by extracting the page ID from the loaded page when the URL has no ID.
acceptanceCriteria: Add content-side page identity extraction for Confluence DOM metadata and bootstrap data on display URLs
Popup or background detection passes the extracted page ID to `src/confluence/detector.ts` without requiring Notion auth state in the content script
Content-side messages never include Notion access tokens, refresh tokens, cookies, or authorization headers
Manifest wiring loads the page identity bridge only where needed for configured Confluence pages
Unsupported display pages still show the existing clear unsupported-page guidance
Tests cover DOM metadata extraction, bootstrap extraction, no-page-id fallback, token-free messaging, and detector integration
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added content-side Confluence page identity extraction, popup/background identity forwarding, on-demand content-script injection, and detector integration coverage.

userStories.title: Render uploaded assets at original document positions
userStories.description: As a user, I need images and asset fallbacks to appear where they were referenced in the Confluence page, not appended after all converted content.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversion or asset handling represents each image or attachment reference with a stable placeholder or asset identity at its original block position
The save pipeline replaces uploaded asset placeholders with final Notion file/image blocks in original document order
Failed image uploads preserve the original Confluence source link at the original position
Asset failures increment warning count without adding noisy per-image error callout blocks
Successful saves no longer append all rendered asset blocks after converted content
Integration tests cover multiple images interleaved with paragraphs, failed upload fallback in place, and no per-image error callouts
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Notion file upload attach-window validation
userStories.description: As a user, I need Notion file uploads attached only when their expiry window is still valid, so saved image blocks do not break immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed Notion file upload with no expiry is attachable
A completed Notion file upload with an expiry timestamp in the future at attach time is attachable
A completed Notion file upload with an expiry timestamp at or before attach time is treated as expired
Expired uploads degrade to the original source link with a warning instead of producing a Notion upload block
Boundary tests cover no expiry, future expiry, already expired expiry, and equality-at-now expiry
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Mark partial Notion writes clearly in summaries
userStories.description: As a user, I need failures after Notion page creation to be reported as partial writes with the partial page URL preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Notion append failure after page creation produces a terminal failed summary marked explicitly as partial
Partial write summaries retain the created Notion page ID or URL when available
Partial write summaries include user-visible guidance that a half-created Notion page may exist and should be inspected or deleted manually
Partial write handling does not archive, delete, clear, or reuse the partial Notion page
Popup terminal result renders the partial marker and partial page URL when present
Tests cover writer partial result, save pipeline summary, popup partial rendering, and no cleanup attempt
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Make Popup observe active task progress after mount
userStories.description: As a user, I need the Popup to keep updating while a long save runs in the background, even if progress changes after the Popup first opens.
acceptanceCriteria: Popup subscribes to active ClipTask storage changes or polls active task state after mount
Popup updates visible stage text when task status changes through detecting, fetching, parsing, converting, uploading assets, and writing
Popup shows terminal success or failure summary when the background task completes after mount
Duplicate save click during an observed active task shows existing progress and does not start a second task
Popup cleanup removes subscriptions or timers when unmounted
Tests cover progress update after mount, terminal update after mount, duplicate click during active task, and cleanup behavior
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
